name: D9 zero-preserving amplitude-times-shape confirmation
purpose: prevent scale-invariant BIC from promoting microscopic model residue on exact-zero physical responses
scope: TRAIN-only same-example confirmation; cannot authorize DEV, TEST, deployment, or visual transfer

data.selection: identical eight groups used by D6-D8b audits

model.encoder: unchanged D8b raw temporal endpoint encoder and level context
model.factorization: predicted log-separation equals ReLU amplitude times softplus normalized shape
model.amplitude_target: RMS magnitude of the 41-dimensional continuous log1p gap/curve target per group and level
model.shape_target: target divided by amplitude for nonzero-amplitude levels only
model.zero_handling: shape loss omitted exactly when continuous target amplitude is zero

optimization.batching: deterministic full batch of all eight groups and six levels
optimization.loss: amplitude MSE plus five equally weighted masked shape MSE terms
optimization.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step for every seed; no best-seed or intermediate selection

replication_decision: all three fixed final checkpoints must pass every per-seed gate

interpretation.all_pass: authorize one episode-held-out TRAIN comparison against D2
interpretation.any_fail: zero-preserving parameterization is not yet stable; keep held-out TRAIN closed
